examples.name: Add a Default Label
examples.map:
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: MutatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: "add-managed-by-label"
spec:
  # failurePolicy: how the apiserver reacts if this policy fails to
  # evaluate (Fail = deny the request, Ignore = skip the mutation).
  # reinvocationPolicy: whether the mutation list may run more than once
  # if other policies also mutate the object (Never = run it once).
  failurePolicy: Fail
  reinvocationPolicy: Never
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - apiGroups:   ["apps"]
      apiVersions: ["v1"]
      operations:  ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
      resources:   ["deployments"]
  mutations:
  # ApplyConfiguration merges this fragment into the object with
  # server-side-apply semantics: the returned labels are added to the
  # existing ones, so the object's own "app" label is kept, not replaced.
  - patchType: ApplyConfiguration
    applyConfiguration:
      expression: >
        Object{
          metadata: Object.metadata{
            labels: {"app.kubernetes.io/managed-by": "mutating-admission-policy"}
          }
        }
examples.dataObject:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app: nginx
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nginx
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.27

examples.name: Inject a Sidecar Container
examples.map:
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: MutatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: "inject-sidecar"
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  # IfNeeded: if a later policy mutates the object, run this mutation
  # again so the injected sidecar is not lost. This is the recommended
  # setting for injection policies.
  reinvocationPolicy: IfNeeded
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - apiGroups:   ["apps"]
      apiVersions: ["v1"]
      operations:  ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
      resources:   ["deployments"]
  mutations:
  # A "native sidecar" is an initContainer with restartPolicy: Always
  # (Kubernetes 1.28+). initContainers has listType=map keyed by name, so
  # server-side-apply merges by name: the existing "setup" initContainer
  # is preserved and "mesh-proxy" is added alongside it.
  - patchType: ApplyConfiguration
    applyConfiguration:
      expression: >
        Object{
          spec: Object.spec{
            template: Object.spec.template{
              spec: Object.spec.template.spec{
                initContainers: [
                  Object.spec.template.spec.initContainers{
                    name: "mesh-proxy",
                    image: "registry.example.com/mesh/proxy:v1.0.0",
                    restartPolicy: "Always"
                  }
                ]
              }
            }
          }
        }
examples.dataObject:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nginx
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx
    spec:
      initContainers:
      - name: setup
        image: busybox:1.36
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx:1.27

examples.name: JSON Patch
examples.map:
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: MutatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: "jsonpatch-remove-and-escape"
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  reinvocationPolicy: Never
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - apiGroups:   ["apps"]
      apiVersions: ["v1"]
      operations:  ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
      resources:   ["deployments"]
  mutations:
  # JSONPatch is for what ApplyConfiguration cannot express. Here:
  #   - "remove" deletes a field outright (an apply-configuration can only
  #     add or overwrite, never unset).
  #   - the second op adds a label whose key contains "/". In a JSON
  #     Pointer path "/" is the separator, so it must be escaped as "~1";
  #     jsonpatch.escapeKey() does that ("example.com/owner" -> "example.com~1owner").
  - patchType: JSONPatch
    jsonPatch:
      expression: >
        [
          JSONPatch{op: "remove", path: "/metadata/annotations/deprecated"},
          JSONPatch{
            op: "add",
            path: "/metadata/labels/" + jsonpatch.escapeKey("example.com/owner"),
            value: "sre"
          }
        ]
examples.dataObject:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx
  namespace: default
  labels:
    app: nginx
  annotations:
    deprecated: "true"
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: nginx
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx
    spec:
      containers:

examples.name: Variables in Mutation
examples.map:
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: MutatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: "backfill-recommended-name"
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  reinvocationPolicy: Never
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - apiGroups:   ["apps"]
      apiVersions: ["v1"]
      operations:  ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
      resources:   ["deployments"]
  variables:
  # Compute a value once and reuse it below as variables.appName.
  # Delete the object's "app" label to see the 'unknown' fallback branch.
  - name: appName
    expression: "'app' in object.metadata.labels ? object.metadata.labels['app'] : 'unknown'"
  mutations:
  # Backfill the recommended label app.kubernetes.io/name from the legacy
  # "app" label -- the mutation copies variables.appName, so the output
  # value is visibly the one the variable computed.
  - patchType: ApplyConfiguration
    applyConfiguration:
      expression: >
        Object{
          metadata: Object.metadata{
            labels: {"app.kubernetes.io/name": variables.appName}
          }
        }

examples.name: Conditional Mutation
examples.map:
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: MutatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: "default-tier-if-absent"
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  reinvocationPolicy: Never
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - apiGroups:   ["apps"]
      apiVersions: ["v1"]
      operations:  ["CREATE", "UPDATE"]
      resources:   ["deployments"]
  # matchConditions gate whether the mutation runs at all -- use them for
  # checks a label/namespace selector cannot express. This one is a
  # set-if-absent guard: only default the "tier" label when it is missing.
  # Add `tier: <anything>` to the object's labels and re-run: the
  # condition becomes false and the object comes back unchanged.
  matchConditions:
  - name: tier-not-set
    expression: "!has(object.metadata.labels) || !('tier' in object.metadata.labels)"
  mutations:
  - patchType: ApplyConfiguration
    applyConfiguration:
      expression: >
        Object{
          metadata: Object.metadata{
            labels: {"tier": "standard"}
          }
        }

examples.name: Admission Context
examples.map:
apiVersion: admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1
kind: MutatingAdmissionPolicy
metadata:
  name: "record-admission-context"
spec:
  failurePolicy: Fail
  reinvocationPolicy: Never
  # UPDATE only: the mutation reads oldObject, which is null on CREATE.
  # Matching CREATE too would error here under failurePolicy: Fail.
  matchConstraints:
    resourceRules:
    - apiGroups:   ["apps"]
      apiVersions: ["v1"]
      operations:  ["UPDATE"]
      resources:   ["deployments"]
  mutations:
  # Every value comes from a different context binding available to a
  # policy -- one annotation per input tab, so the result reads as a
  # legend for what each binding holds.
  - patchType: ApplyConfiguration
    applyConfiguration:
      expression: >
        Object{
          metadata: Object.metadata{
            annotations: {
              "playground.example.com/operation": string(request.operation),
              "playground.example.com/changed-by": request.userInfo.username,
              "playground.example.com/environment": namespaceObject.metadata.labels["environment"],
              "playground.example.com/scaled-from": string(oldObject.spec.replicas),
              "playground.example.com/may-scale": string(
                authorizer.group("apps").resource("deployments").check("update").allowed()
              )
            }
          }
        }
